The '''''Iota''-class TS-485 light shuttle''', also simply known as the '''Imperial light shuttle''', was an unarmed light [[shuttle]] used by the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. It was considered a compact version of the Lambda shuttle. It was intended for short trips, although it did have a hyperdrive for when the need arose.<ref name="History 76" /> [[Tala Durith]], an [[Imperial officer]]-turned-[[Hidden Path]] member,<ref name="Part V">{{Kenobi|Part V}}</ref> used a [[Tala Durith's shuttle|shuttle of the type]].<ref name="History 76" />
